title_vi: Tường thuật câu trần thuật: mệnh đề that
theory_html:
A. that-clauses; leaving out that

A. Mệnh đề that; bỏ that

When we report statements, we often use a that-clause in the reported clause:

Khi tường thuật câu trần thuật, ta thường dùng mệnh đề that trong mệnh đề được tường thuật:

  • He said (that) he was enjoying his work.

    Anh ấy nói (rằng) anh ấy đang rất thích công việc.

  • The members of the Security Council warned that further action may be taken.

    Các thành viên Hội đồng Bảo an cảnh báo rằng có thể có thêm hành động.

After the more common reporting verbs such as agree, mention, notice, promise, say, and think, we often leave out that, particularly in informal speech. However, it is not usually left out: after less common reporting verbs such as complain, confide, deny, grumble, speculate, warn (and after the common reporting verbs answer, argue, and reply); in formal writing; if the that-clause doesn’t immediately follow the verb:

Sau các động từ tường thuật phổ biến như agree, mention, notice, promise, say, think, ta thường bỏ that, nhất là trong văn nói thân mật. Tuy nhiên, thường không bỏ: sau các động từ ít phổ biến như complain, confide, deny, grumble, speculate, warn (và sau answer, argue, reply); trong văn viết trang trọng; khi mệnh đề that không đứng ngay sau động từ:

  • She agreed with her parents and brothers that it would be safer to buy a car than a motorbike. (rather than … and brothers it would be safer …)

    Cô ấy đồng ý với bố mẹ và các anh rằng mua ô tô an toàn hơn xe máy.

B. that-clause or object + to-infinitive

B. Mệnh đề that hoặc tân ngữ + to-V

Some reporting verbs which are followed by a that-clause have an alternative with an object + to-infinitive (often to be), although the alternatives are often rather formal. Compare:

Một số động từ tường thuật đi với mệnh đề that có cách thay thế bằng tân ngữ + to-V (thường là to be), dù cách này thường khá trang trọng. So sánh:

  • I felt that the results were satisfactory. / I felt the results to be satisfactory.

    Tôi thấy rằng kết quả là đạt yêu cầu.

Also: acknowledge, assume, believe, consider, declare, expect, find, presume, report, think, understand

Tương tự: acknowledge, assume, believe, consider, declare, expect, find, presume, report, think, understand

C. Object needed before the that-clause

C. Cần tân ngữ trước mệnh đề that

If we use a that-clause after an active form of some verbs, we must include an object between the verb and the that-clause. This object can’t be a prepositional object:

Nếu dùng mệnh đề that sau dạng chủ động của một số động từ, phải có tân ngữ giữa động từ và mệnh đề that. Tân ngữ này không được là tân ngữ giới từ:

  • I notified the bank that I had changed my address. (but not I notified that I … / I notified to the bank that I …)

    Tôi thông báo cho ngân hàng rằng tôi đã đổi địa chỉ.

Also: assure, convince, inform, persuade, reassure, remind, tell

Tương tự: assure, convince, inform, persuade, reassure, remind, tell

However, after some other verbs an object before a that-clause is not always necessary:

Tuy nhiên, sau một số động từ khác không nhất thiết có tân ngữ trước mệnh đề that:

  • They promised (me) that they would come to the party.

    Họ hứa (với tôi) rằng sẽ đến bữa tiệc.

Also: advise, show, teach, warn

Tương tự: advise, show, teach, warn

D. Preposition + object before the that-clause

D. Giới từ + tân ngữ trước mệnh đề that

After some verbs we can use a that-clause with or without a personal object before the that-clause. However, if we do include an object, we put a preposition before it. After some verbs we use to:

Sau một số động từ, có thể dùng mệnh đề that có hoặc không có tân ngữ chỉ người phía trước. Nhưng nếu có tân ngữ thì đặt giới từ trước nó. Sau một số động từ dùng to:

  • She admitted (to me) that she was seriously ill.

    Cô ấy thừa nhận (với tôi) rằng mình bị bệnh nặng.

  • I pointed out (to the driver) that he had parked across the entrance.

    Tôi chỉ ra (cho tài xế) rằng anh ta đỗ xe chắn lối vào.

Also: announce, complain, confess, explain, indicate, mention, propose, recommend, report, say, suggest

Tương tự: announce, complain, confess, explain, indicate, mention, propose, recommend, report, say, suggest

After some verbs we use with:

Sau một số động từ dùng with:

  • We agreed (with Ella) that the information should go no further.

    Chúng tôi thống nhất (với Ella) rằng thông tin không được lan ra ngoài.

Also: argue, check, disagree, joke

Tương tự: argue, check, disagree, joke

After the verbs ask, demand and require we use of:

Sau ask, demand, require dùng of:

  • The club asks (of its members) that they pay their fees by 31st December.

    Câu lạc bộ yêu cầu (các thành viên) đóng phí trước ngày 31 tháng Mười Hai.

  • The company demands (of its staff) that they should be at work by 8:30.

    Công ty đòi hỏi (nhân viên) phải có mặt trước 8 giờ 30.

This pattern is usually used in formal contexts. Less formally we can use a to-infinitive clause after ask and require (e.g. The club asks its members to pay their fees by 31st December). However, we can’t use a to-infinitive clause after demand (not The company demands its staff to …).

Cấu trúc này thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh trang trọng. Ít trang trọng hơn, có thể dùng mệnh đề to-V sau ask và require. Tuy nhiên, không dùng mệnh đề to-V sau demand (không nói The company demands its staff to …).

mcq.question: She agreed with her parents and brothers ___ it would be safer to buy a car than a motorbike.
mcq.full: She agreed with her parents and brothers that it would be safer to buy a car than a motorbike.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy đồng ý với bố mẹ và các anh rằng mua ô tô an toàn hơn xe máy.
mcq.expl:
that can be omitted after common verbs (say, think, agree, mention, promise) in informal speech; keep it after complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, in formal writing, and when the clause doesn’t follow the verb directly.
Có thể bỏ that sau động từ phổ biến (say, think, agree, mention, promise) trong văn nói; giữ that sau complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, trong văn viết trang trọng, và khi mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ → giữ that.
mcq.key: She agreed with her parents and brothers ___ it would be safer to buy a car than a motorbike.|that

mcq.question: PIK, the toy manufacturer, has warned ___ they are to make over 100 employees redundant.
mcq.full: PIK, the toy manufacturer, has warned that they are to make over 100 employees redundant.
mcq.vi: Hãng đồ chơi PIK cảnh báo rằng họ sẽ cắt giảm hơn 100 nhân viên.
mcq.expl:
that can be omitted after common verbs (say, think, agree, mention, promise) in informal speech; keep it after complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, in formal writing, and when the clause doesn’t follow the verb directly.
Có thể bỏ that sau động từ phổ biến (say, think, agree, mention, promise) trong văn nói; giữ that sau complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, trong văn viết trang trọng, và khi mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau warn, văn trang trọng → giữ that.
mcq.key: PIK, the toy manufacturer, has warned ___ they are to make over 100 employees redundant.|that

mcq.question: But she denied ___ management had been incompetent.
mcq.full: But she denied that management had been incompetent.
mcq.vi: Nhưng bà phủ nhận rằng ban quản lý kém cỏi.
mcq.expl:
that can be omitted after common verbs (say, think, agree, mention, promise) in informal speech; keep it after complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, in formal writing, and when the clause doesn’t follow the verb directly.
Có thể bỏ that sau động từ phổ biến (say, think, agree, mention, promise) trong văn nói; giữ that sau complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, trong văn viết trang trọng, và khi mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau deny → thường giữ that.
mcq.key: But she denied ___ management had been incompetent.|that

mcq.question: When asked whether staff would receive redundancy pay, Ms Edwards replied ___ an announcement would be made within a few days.
mcq.full: When asked whether staff would receive redundancy pay, Ms Edwards replied that an announcement would be made within a few days.
mcq.vi: Khi được hỏi nhân viên có nhận trợ cấp thôi việc không, bà Edwards đáp rằng sẽ có thông báo trong vài ngày.
mcq.expl:
that can be omitted after common verbs (say, think, agree, mention, promise) in informal speech; keep it after complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, in formal writing, and when the clause doesn’t follow the verb directly.
Có thể bỏ that sau động từ phổ biến (say, think, agree, mention, promise) trong văn nói; giữ that sau complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, trong văn viết trang trọng, và khi mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau reply → giữ that.
mcq.key: When asked whether staff would receive redundancy pay, Ms Edwards replied ___ an announcement would be made within a few days.|that

mcq.question: She went on to complain ___ government help for small businesses was insufficient.
mcq.full: She went on to complain that government help for small businesses was insufficient.
mcq.vi: Bà còn phàn nàn rằng hỗ trợ của chính phủ cho doanh nghiệp nhỏ là không đủ.
mcq.expl:
that can be omitted after common verbs (say, think, agree, mention, promise) in informal speech; keep it after complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, in formal writing, and when the clause doesn’t follow the verb directly.
Có thể bỏ that sau động từ phổ biến (say, think, agree, mention, promise) trong văn nói; giữ that sau complain / deny / warn / reply / argue, trong văn viết trang trọng, và khi mệnh đề không đứng ngay sau động từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sau complain → giữ that.
mcq.key: She went on to complain ___ government help for small businesses was insufficient.|that

mcq.question: I felt the results ___ satisfactory.
mcq.full: I felt the results to be satisfactory.
mcq.vi: Tôi thấy kết quả là đạt yêu cầu.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: feel + O + to be (trang trọng).
mcq.key: I felt the results ___ satisfactory.|to be

mcq.question: Two days after the launch Houston reported the satellite ___ missing.
mcq.full: Two days after the launch Houston reported the satellite to be missing.
mcq.vi: Hai ngày sau khi phóng, Houston báo cáo vệ tinh đã mất tích.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: report + O + to be.
mcq.key: Two days after the launch Houston reported the satellite ___ missing.|to be

mcq.question: The judge thought his explanation ___ unconvincing.
mcq.full: The judge thought his explanation to be unconvincing.
mcq.vi: Thẩm phán cho rằng lời giải thích của anh ta là không thuyết phục.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: think + O + to be.
mcq.key: The judge thought his explanation ___ unconvincing.|to be

mcq.question: I expected her plans ___.
mcq.full: I expected her plans to fail.
mcq.vi: Tôi đã nghĩ kế hoạch của cô ấy sẽ thất bại.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: expect + O + to-V.
mcq.key: I expected her plans ___.|to fail

mcq.question: Lucas acknowledged his chances of winning the race ___ slim.
mcq.full: Lucas acknowledged his chances of winning the race to be slim.
mcq.vi: Lucas thừa nhận cơ hội thắng cuộc đua của mình là mong manh.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: acknowledge + O + to be.
mcq.key: Lucas acknowledged his chances of winning the race ___ slim.|to be

mcq.question: We found the rugby supporters ___ very well behaved.
mcq.full: We found the rugby supporters to be very well behaved.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi thấy cổ động viên bóng bầu dục rất có ý thức.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: find + O + to be.
mcq.key: We found the rugby supporters ___ very well behaved.|to be

mcq.question: The employees argued ___ the reduction in wages was unlawful.
mcq.full: The employees argued that the reduction in wages was unlawful.
mcq.vi: Nhân viên lập luận rằng việc giảm lương là trái luật.
mcq.expl:
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + that-clause or + object + to be (formal); not argue / stress / comment.
feel / think / believe / consider / expect / find / acknowledge + mệnh đề that hoặc + tân ngữ + to be (trang trọng); không dùng với argue / stress / comment.
Điểm ngữ pháp: argue không dùng O + to be.
mcq.key: The employees argued ___ the reduction in wages was unlawful.|that

mcq.question: I notified ___ that I had changed my address.
mcq.full: I notified the bank that I had changed my address.
mcq.vi: Tôi thông báo cho ngân hàng rằng tôi đã đổi địa chỉ.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: notify + O + that (không dùng giới từ).
mcq.key: I notified ___ that I had changed my address.|the bank

mcq.question: The doctors ___ that I should rest for three months.
mcq.full: The doctors advised that I should rest for three months.
mcq.vi: Các bác sĩ khuyên tôi nên nghỉ ngơi ba tháng.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: advise không bắt buộc tân ngữ; persuade bắt buộc.
mcq.key: The doctors ___ that I should rest for three months.|advised

mcq.question: The police ___ residents that everything possible was being done to catch the thieves.
mcq.full: The police assured residents that everything possible was being done to catch the thieves.
mcq.vi: Cảnh sát cam đoan với người dân rằng mọi biện pháp đang được thực hiện để bắt bọn trộm.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: assure + O + that.
mcq.key: The police ___ residents that everything possible was being done to catch the thieves.|assured

mcq.question: A spokesperson for the company ___ that there may be delays on the railways this summer.
mcq.full: A spokesperson for the company warned that there may be delays on the railways this summer.
mcq.vi: Người phát ngôn công ty cảnh báo có thể có chậm trễ trên đường sắt mùa hè này.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: warn không bắt buộc tân ngữ; remind bắt buộc.
mcq.key: A spokesperson for the company ___ that there may be delays on the railways this summer.|warned

mcq.question: Russian scientists ___ that honey can prevent the growth of bacteria.
mcq.full: Russian scientists have shown that honey can prevent the growth of bacteria.
mcq.vi: Các nhà khoa học Nga đã chứng minh mật ong có thể ngăn vi khuẩn phát triển.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: show không bắt buộc tân ngữ.
mcq.key: Russian scientists ___ that honey can prevent the growth of bacteria.|have shown

mcq.question: Katarina ___ that she would be home before midnight.
mcq.full: Katarina promised that she would be home before midnight.
mcq.vi: Katarina hứa sẽ về nhà trước nửa đêm.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: promise không bắt buộc tân ngữ; tell bắt buộc.
mcq.key: Katarina ___ that she would be home before midnight.|promised

mcq.question: She reassured ___ that they would receive financial compensation.
mcq.full: She reassured employees that they would receive financial compensation.
mcq.vi: Bà trấn an nhân viên rằng họ sẽ nhận được bồi thường tài chính.
mcq.expl:
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + object + that-clause; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (object) + that.
tell / inform / notify / assure / convince / persuade / reassure / remind + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that; promise / advise / show / teach / warn + (tân ngữ) + that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: reassure + O + that.
mcq.key: She reassured ___ that they would receive financial compensation.|employees

mcq.question: She admitted ___ me that she was seriously ill.
mcq.full: She admitted to me that she was seriously ill.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy thừa nhận với tôi rằng mình bị bệnh nặng.
mcq.expl:
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + object) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + object) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + object) + that (not demand + object + to-infinitive).
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + tân ngữ) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + tân ngữ) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + tân ngữ) + that (không dùng demand + tân ngữ + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: admit + (to + O) + that.
mcq.key: She admitted ___ me that she was seriously ill.|to

mcq.question: I pointed out ___ the driver that he had parked across the entrance.
mcq.full: I pointed out to the driver that he had parked across the entrance.
mcq.vi: Tôi chỉ ra cho tài xế rằng anh ta đỗ xe chắn lối vào.
mcq.expl:
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + object) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + object) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + object) + that (not demand + object + to-infinitive).
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + tân ngữ) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + tân ngữ) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + tân ngữ) + that (không dùng demand + tân ngữ + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: point out + (to + O) + that.
mcq.key: I pointed out ___ the driver that he had parked across the entrance.|to

mcq.question: We agreed ___ Ella that the information should go no further.
mcq.full: We agreed with Ella that the information should go no further.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi thống nhất với Ella rằng thông tin không được lan ra ngoài.
mcq.expl:
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + object) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + object) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + object) + that (not demand + object + to-infinitive).
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + tân ngữ) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + tân ngữ) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + tân ngữ) + that (không dùng demand + tân ngữ + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + (with + O) + that.
mcq.key: We agreed ___ Ella that the information should go no further.|with

mcq.question: The club asks ___ its members that they pay their fees by 31st December.
mcq.full: The club asks of its members that they pay their fees by 31st December.
mcq.vi: Câu lạc bộ yêu cầu ở các thành viên đóng phí trước ngày 31 tháng Mười Hai.
mcq.expl:
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + object) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + object) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + object) + that (not demand + object + to-infinitive).
admit / explain / mention / complain / point out / announce + (to + tân ngữ) + that; agree / argue / disagree / joke + (with + tân ngữ) + that; ask / demand / require + (of + tân ngữ) + that (không dùng demand + tân ngữ + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + (of + O) + that (trang trọng).
mcq.key: The club asks ___ its members that they pay their fees by 31st December.|of

mcq.question: The company demands ___ its staff that they should be at work by 8:30.
mcq.full: The company demands of its staff that they should be at work by 8:30.
